page.layout: One printed page of text, single column, with page number at the head. No margin notes. Running text in full-width lines ending with a catchword-like word "ptione" set at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: quæ administratio illic rigidior, operosior, obscurior, hic suavior, facilior clarior, illic magis restricta & limitata, hic vero amplior magisque extensa.

II. Neutiquam verò discrepantia illa quæ-renda in donis salutiferis, justificatione, adoptione, sanctificatione, charitate, inscri-ptione legis in cordibus, pace cum Deo, tran-quillitate conscientiæ, quæ charismata utro-bique eadem.
III. Nec aliter fieri potuit, quia utrobi-que per fidem conscientiis fuit applicatum u-num idemque meritum efficacissimum, pretium sc. sanguinis Filii Dei, sive jam in carne exhi-biti sive exhibendi.

Ex hisce profesto Corollariis eorumque comparatione cum prioribus videre erat, non constare sibi D. Spanhemium atque in pejus eum proficere; siquidem priori disputatione agnovit sub N. Test. majorem esse παρρησίαν, χαράν, καύχησιν, atque in posteriori asseruit discrepantiam inter Oeco-nomiam Veteris & illam N. Test. non esse quæ-rendam in donis salutiferis, justificatione, adoptione, sanctificatione, charitate, inscri-ptione

page.notes: Greek words (παρρησίαν, χαράν, καύχησιν) transcribed as printed with approximate accents. Page is set in italic and roman mix; italic passages marked in prose only in part. Catchword "ptione" is taken as the word at the foot right; the top line "quæ administratio" is printed in italic. Some faint show-through from the reverse page was ignored.
